source_chain: Declared vLLM0.24 ordinary TP1 input_.long() maps INT32 IDs to a distinct INT64 tensor; the declared compiler/library is the existing Torch2.4+MACA3.7.2 artifact, not proof of the captured0.24 runtime.
direct_copy_kernel_cuda0x16b00c0 selects the Long-output functor at0x16b0210 ->gpu_kernel_maca_arity1_copy0x16df380 ->gpu_kernel_impl_maca_arity1_copy0x16df580.
Loops_copy.cuh checks empty/split iterators; CUDALoops_copy.cuh chooses contiguous differing-dtype LoadWithCast/StoreWithCast unrolled launch below2048 elements.

CUDALoops_copy.cuh has an optimized-copy branch for aligned N>=2048 including Long/Int, controlled by get_maca_disable_unroll_float_opt. Presence of the generic device symbol alone does not bind that larger domain.
thread_constants.h: USE_MACA num_threads=256,thread_work_size=4; launch_unrolled_kernel grid=ceil(N/1024). Device block stride is1024 with four predicated slots.
Xcore1000 code: INT32 branch LDG_B32@0x546328, ASHR_I32(highword,31,lowword)@0x546338; repeats at0x547948/0x548fa0/0x54a690. INT64 destination stores8B per active slot; no floating conversion.

The existing pinned host dispatch at0x16df749 branches to the same generic entry0x16e1869 when get_maca_disable_unroll_float_opt is true, independently of alignment and N. Thus explicitly disabled N>=2048 reuses the retained256x4/22-register entry within an unsplit32bit byte extent; this is not inference from symbol presence.

Reusing the retained bundle51 Xcore1000 code and MsgPack ELF descriptor: exact Long-output functor full int_to_long0x542700 and tail0x542800 have mtreg10/streg16 andmtreg10/streg20 respectively, with zero private/shared. Source emits256threads/vt2/ceil(N/512). Two packed ASHR_I32 or one per scalar residual give exactly one sign extension per element, never a floating conversion.

accepted_scope.elements: 1<=N<2048 without dispatch facts; or2048<=N with8*N<2^31 and explicit Copy flag; enabled branch additionally requires both actual pointers>=4B-aligned
accepted_scope.integer_work: one source-proven32-bit arithmetic sign extension per element using existing integer ALU service
accepted_scope.large_copy_dispatch: same exact flag/input/output-alignment mapping as the BF16-to-FP32 Copy contract; disabled selects genericvt4/22registers, enabled+proven4B selects optimizedvt2/10registers with separate full/tail entry

excluded: N>=2048 with absent flag, enabled optimization without proven4B input/output alignment, split iterator or unproven32bit byte extent
actual GPU/provider/runtime or latency accuracy validation
pricing_limitations: iterator addressing,uniform and dtype-dispatch instructions excluded as in the existing shared integer materialization model
source-role bytes are not measured DRAM traffic or a cache-hit observation
no new throughput/latency values or production task-duration floors
